ModMetaData.name: Freeform Lines
ModMetaData.author: Merthsoft, Jacbo; art by Halno
ModMetaData.description:
Adds continuous freeform lines to the vanilla drawing palette. Select a supported build, mine or zone tool, select freeform line, then hold and drag to paint a one-cell-wide continuous path.
Extracted from Designator Shapes. Code by Merthsoft; original freeform tool by Jacbo; art by Halno. Unlicense.
